params.description: Backward compatibility of the `departmentAdmins` field. If `true`, the `departmentAdmins` field in the returned departments is not set. If `false`, the `departmentAdmins` is set in the returned departments.

params.description: Memory returned in MB. When set to `false` (default) memory will be returned in MiB.
